      #greenhouse-job-board-wrapper, .gh-atomic-container, .filters-container {

      /* =========================================
         FILTER DESIGN (PILLS & SEARCH)

      .cmt-filter-section {
          display: flex; gap: 48px; margin-bottom: 60px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end;
      }
      .cmt-filter-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }

      .cmt-filter-col label {
          font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;
          color: var(--cmt-text-gray); letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 4px;
      }

      .cmt-search-wrapper { position: relative; width: 320px; max-width: 100%; }
      .cmt-search-wrapper input {
          width: 100%; padding: 8px 0 12px 0; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--cmt-border);
          font-size: 18px; color: var(--cmt-dark); outline: none; background: transparent;
          font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.2s;
      }
      .cmt-search-wrapper input::placeholder { color: #94A3B8; }
      .cmt-search-wrapper input:focus { border-bottom-color: var(--cmt-dark); }

      .cmt-pill-container { display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; }
      .cmt-filter-pill {
          background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid var(--cmt-border); border-radius: 999px;
          padding: 8px 20px; font-size: 15px; color: var(--cmt-dark); cursor: pointer;
          font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; transition: all 0.2s; white-space: nowrap;
      }
      .cmt-filter-pill:hover { border-color: var(--cmt-dark); }
      .cmt-filter-pill.active { background: var(--cmt-dark); color: #ffffff; border-color: var(--cmt-dark); }

      .cmt-roles-count {
          font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600;
          color: var(--cmt-text-gray); letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase;
          margin-bottom: 24px; display: block;
      }

      /* =========================================
         LISTEN-DESIGN (Standard Layout)
         ========================================= */
      .department-title { font-size: 22px; color: #2F8CFF; margin-top: 50px; margin-bottom: 15px; font-weight: 800; }

      .cmt-rf-row {
          display: flex !important; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
          gap: 24px; padding: 28px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--cmt-border);
          text-decoration: none; color: inherit;
          transition: background 140ms ease;
      }

      .cmt-rf-row:hover {
          background: #F4F6F8; padding-left: 12px; padding-right: 12px;
          margin-left: -12px; margin-right: -12px; border-radius: 8px;
      }

      .cmt-rf-row:hover + .cmt-rf-row, .cmt-rf-row:hover { border-top-color: transparent; }
      .cmt-rf-row:last-child { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--cmt-border); }
      .department-group .cmt-rf-row:first-of-type { border-top-color: var(--cmt-dark); }

      /* Hover-Fix: höhere Spezifität, damit die schwarze first-of-type-Linie
         beim Hover ebenfalls transparent wird (sonst verzieht border-radius
         die Ecken sichtbar). */
      .department-group .cmt-rf-row:hover,
      .department-group .cmt-rf-row:hover + .cmt-rf-row {
          border-top-color: transparent;
      }

      .cmt-rf-row .title {
          font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
          font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.3;
          color: var(--cmt-dark); letter-spacing: -0.015em;
          margin: 0; flex: 1; min-width: 0;
      }

      .cmt-rf-tags { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 32px; flex-shrink: 0; }

      .cmt-rf-row .meta, .cmt-rf-row .loc {
          font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace !important;
          font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1;
          color: var(--cmt-text-gray); letter-spacing: 0.05em; white-space: nowrap;
      }

      @media (max-width: 600px) {
          .cmt-filter-section { gap: 32px; }
          .cmt-search-wrapper { width: 100%; }
          .cmt-rf-row { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; }
          .cmt-rf-tags { gap: 16px; }
      }

      /* =========================================
         BENTO-GRID LAYOUT (layout="grid")
         ========================================= */
      #greenhouse-job-board-wrapper[data-layout="grid"] #greenhouse-job-board {
          display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 20px; grid-auto-rows: 210px;
      }
      #greenhouse-job-board-wrapper[data-layout="grid"] .job-item {
          background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid var(--cmt-border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px;
          display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end;
          text-decoration: none; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; grid-column: span 1;
      }
      #greenhouse-job-board-wrapper[data-layout="grid"] .job-item:hover {
          transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 15px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); background-color: #ffffff;
      }
      .job-item-number {
          display: none; position: absolute; top: 24px; left: 24px;
          font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Inter', monospace; color: var(--cmt-blue);
      }
      #greenhouse-job-board-wrapper[data-layout="grid"] .job-item-number { display: block; }
      #greenhouse-job-board-wrapper[data-layout="grid"] .job-title {
          font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 5px 0;
          display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden;
      }
      #greenhouse-job-board-wrapper[data-layout="grid"] .job-location { font-size: 16px; color: #666; margin: 0; }
      #greenhouse-job-board-wrapper[data-layout="grid"] .job-item:nth-child(9n + 1),
      #greenhouse-job-board-wrapper[data-layout="grid"] .job-item:nth-child(9n + 5),
      #greenhouse-job-board-wrapper[data-layout="grid"] .job-item:nth-child(9n + 9) {
          grid-column: span 2; background: var(--cmt-gray); border: none;
      }
      #greenhouse-job-board-wrapper[data-layout="grid"] .job-item:first-child { background: var(--cmt-blue); }
      #greenhouse-job-board-wrapper[data-layout="grid"] .job-item:first-child .job-title,
      #greenhouse-job-board-wrapper[data-layout="grid"] .job-item:first-child .job-location,
      #greenhouse-job-board-wrapper[data-layout="grid"] .job-item:first-child .job-item-number { color: #ffffff; }

      @media (max-width: 900px) {
          #greenhouse-job-board-wrapper[data-layout="grid"] #greenhouse-job-board {
              grid-template-columns: 1fr; grid-auto-rows: auto; min-height: 200px;
          }
          #greenhouse-job-board-wrapper[data-layout="grid"] .job-item { grid-column: span 1 !important; padding-top: 80px; }
      }

      /* =========================================
         APPLY BUTTON (Detailseite)
         ========================================= */
      .apply-btn {
          background: var(--cmt-blue);
          color: #ffffff;
          border: none;
          padding: 14px 32px;
          border-radius: 999px;
          font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif;
          font-size: 16px;
          font-weight: 600;
          cursor: pointer;
          transition: background 0.2s;
          display: inline-flex;
          align-items: center;
          gap: 8px;
          text-decoration: none;
          line-height: 1;
      }
      .apply-btn:hover,
      .apply-btn:focus {
          background: #1E78E8;
          color: #ffffff;
          text-decoration: none;
      }

          height: auto !important;
          max-height: none !important;
